title: The Covenant of Water
author: Abraham Verghese
summary: Beginning in 1900, a girl in Kerala is married to an older widower and moves into his family estate. Over generations, her descendants are marked by a strange condition in which a family member in each generation drowns.
readIf: you want an immersive, unhurried multigenerational novel set among doctors, boats and rivers.
skipIf: you want pace and brevity; it is over seven hundred pages and takes its time.

pairings.reason: The author's earlier novel, with the same love of medicine, family secrets and long arcs of time.
Another story of women's resilience across decades, tighter and more tragic.
Also set in Kerala, but a compressed, poetic tragedy compared with this book's slow river of events.
